facts.fact: Leyman Publications reports that on Wednesday 18 February 2026 the Ministry of ICT, through the Department of E-Government, 'commenced' a two-day National Validation Workshop on the 'Draft National Digital Transformation Strategy' to scrutinise and validate it 'before finalisation'; the PS for E-Government says it will strengthen digital public infrastructure, make government systems interoperable, improve national connectivity including rural access and establish a stronger legal and regulatory framework; adoption is still future ('Once adopted').

The same report says the draft strategies 'were developed following' a Digital Readiness Assessment and an AI Landscape Assessment, as well as technical consultations and regional multi-stakeholder engagements conducted in August 2025.

On 18 February 2026 the validation workshop on the Draft National Digital Transformation Strategy opened, with representatives of government, regulators, private sector, civil society, academia and partners, and government launched the 'Shape Malawi's Digital and AI Future Portal' for public feedback before finalisation.
